import subprocess

# Test 1: split with maxsplit=0 on iterator - should return [[1, 2, 3]]
code = r'''
from boltons.iterutils import split

result = split(iter([1, 2, 3]), sep=2, maxsplit=0)
print("Result:", result)
assert result == [[1, 2, 3]], f"Expected [[1, 2, 3]], got {result}"
print("PASS: iterator case")
'''
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', code], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
print(result.stdout)
